title: Intel: Cyclical Recovery or Secular Demise? - [Business Breakdowns, EP.149]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: In the late 80s, a newly appointed CEO, Andy Grove, pivoted to exit memory chips and focus on logic chips.
reader_summary.overview: In the late 80s, a newly appointed CEO, Andy Grove, pivoted to exit memory chips and focus on logic chips. They were the leading edge chip designer, but Intel missed out on the mobile market and EUV technology as technology shifted. Now they're left playing catch up and falling from their iconic status.

key_points.text: To cover Intel, I am joined by Todd Ahlsten, CIO of Parnassus Investments.
Todd started covering semiconductors in the mid-nineties and has since lived through eight cycles in the sector.
We look at what separates secular changes from cyclical ones, and Todd helps outline what went wrong, what is changing today.
